categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Primarius Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic design automation (EDA) industry, focusing on integrated circuit manufacturing EDA tools, integrated circuit design EDA tools, semiconductor device characteristic testing instruments, and technical development solutions. The company offers comprehensive EDA full-process solutions covering design and manufacturing stages, including manufacturing EDA, design EDA, semiconductor testing systems, and technical development services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced EDA technologies such as device modeling, circuit simulation and verification, standard cell library characterization, and design enablement platforms. It employs methodologies like Design Technology Co-Optimization (DTCO) to enhance collaboration between chip design and manufacturing. The production of hardware testing instruments involves assembly of standardized modules integrated with proprietary software, while software development emphasizes parallel computing, AI integration, and cloud computing to improve speed, accuracy, and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primarius serves leading global semiconductor foundries, memory manufacturers, and integrated circuit design companies, including top-tier clients like TSMC, Samsung, UMC, GlobalFoundries, and SMIC. Its products support chip development for applications in data processing, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, IoT, industrial, and computing peripherals. The company’s customer base spans both domestic Chinese markets and international semiconductor hubs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China, with operational presence across key domestic regions including Beijing, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Jinan, and Fuzhou. Internationally, it has subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Belgium, South Korea, Singapore, and Taiwan. Its business covers over a dozen major global semiconductor industry countries and regions, reflecting a broad global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Primarius operates primarily upstream and midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, providing critical EDA software tools and semiconductor device testing instruments that support chip design and manufacturing processes. It collaborates closely with foundries and design houses, enabling process development and chip design optimization, thus positioning itself as a key technology enabler in the semiconductor ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on advancing DTCO methodologies, expanding its EDA full-process solutions, and integrating AI and cloud computing technologies to enhance automation and efficiency. It prioritizes R&D investment, talent development, and industry collaboration to maintain technological leadership. Recent efforts include acquisitions to broaden product offerings, development of advanced simulation and verification tools, and fostering an ecosystem through partnerships and industry alliances.
categories.revenue_model: Primarius generates revenue primarily through software licensing, including fixed-term and perpetual EDA tool licenses, hardware sales of semiconductor device testing instruments, and provision of technical development solutions. Software licensing revenue is recognized over the license period, with additional income from maintenance and technical support services. Hardware sales revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance, while technical solutions revenue is recognized upon service completion or progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global EDA market is dominated by three major players: Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens EDA. Primarius positions itself as a leading domestic EDA company with international competitiveness, especially in device modeling and circuit simulation segments. It holds significant market share among Chinese semiconductor manufacturers and has gained adoption by global leading foundries and memory manufacturers, establishing a strong foothold in niche and advanced technology areas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Primarius reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 329 million, representing an 18.07% year-over-year increase. Despite revenue growth, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 56.3 million, mainly due to increased R&D and share-based compensation expenses. The company’s R&D investment ratio reached 72.05% of revenue, reflecting aggressive innovation spending. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 2.52 billion, with a slight increase from the previous year, indicating steady growth and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Primarius emphasizes its unique value proposition as the first publicly listed domestic EDA company with internationally competitive core technologies. It differentiates through its comprehensive, application-driven EDA full-process solutions that tightly integrate design and manufacturing stages, supported by proprietary device modeling and circuit simulation tools. The synergy between its software and semiconductor testing hardware enhances data-driven optimization, accelerating chip development cycles and improving yield and performance for customers. Its strategic global footprint and strong industry partnerships further reinforce its competitive edge.
